bear.basis: Conditional forecast-to-terminal bridge; no observed return or capital-efficiency measurement is asserted.
bear.implied_forecast_incremental_roic_basis: Final forecast after-tax EBIT margin times forecast sales-to-capital; a constant-margin incremental-return identity, not measured historical ROIC or a claim about changing-margin incremental returns.
bear.reinvestment_timing_note: Forecast reinvestment uses the current-year revenue increase; terminal reinvestment uses next-year NOPAT times growth/ROIC. Thus cash-flow-equivalent terminal sales-to-capital is ROIC / [after-tax margin * (1 + terminal growth)].

base_terminal_return_at_wacc.fixed_assumptions: Only the return on new terminal investment changes to WACC. Terminal operating margin and growth and every explicit-forecast and equity-bridge input stay fixed; existing asset rents are not separately erased.

disclosures: Forecasts and scenario weights are explicit house assumptions, not reported facts.
Cash operating taxes are zero on losses; no NOL benefit is assumed.
Net debt includes the selected cash balance and is subtracted once. Cash is not added again.
Incremental sales-to-capital represents net operating reinvestment, including working capital. Maintenance investment is assumed to offset depreciation.
Terminal growth consumes reinvestment at terminal ROIC; it is not free growth.
Negative cash flows and negative equity values are preserved; no artificial value floor is applied.
Source references establish traceability only; the caller must verify financial definitions, dates and accounting support.

iphone_growth_persistence.basis: Conditional base-scenario counterfactual, not an observed market input, forecast or replacement for the house scenarios.

fixed_input_basis.note: Only the listed forecast overrides change; actuals, the equity bridge, shares, currency and all unlisted base forecast inputs stay fixed. This case has no scenario probability and does not enter the weighted value.

monitoring.threshold: FY2027 category revenue growth at least 12%, with future disclosed pricing/mix commentary or credible shipment evidence supporting persistence; such evidence is not currently a reported units-times-ASP bridge and may be unavailable; a single quarter is insufficient.
